buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidder shall submit the following valid documents: 1. FSSAI License/Registration issued for the operation of a food/canteen establish ment in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands along with the bid. Bids without a valid FSSA I License/Registration shall be liable for rejection.

2. Documentary proof of the shop/establishment located in Sri Vijaya Puram, A ndaman & Nicobar Islands, such as a valid Trade License, Shop & Establishment Registration, GST Registration, or any other relevant document issued by the Govern ment of India. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The rent of the College Canteen shall beR s. 5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand only) per month for a period of two (02) years from the date of acceptance of the tender. During the vacatio n period, the rent shall be fixed at Rs. 2,000/- (Rupees Two Thousand only) per month on a pro-rata basis for the actual duration of the vacation period. 2. Tender would be awarded to the tenderer quoting the lowest rate of the estimated bid val ue for the food items of the above menu. 3. The tenderer should quote the rates of all items otherwise the tender will be rejected beca use the tender will be decided on the basis of the rates of all items as mentioned above. Th e successful tenderer will be those whose rates come lowest as per the calculation of total r ate of all items. 4. Sale of cigarette, tobacco products and junk food items is not permitted in the college can teen. 5. Usage of LPG burner stove for cooking is permitted. However, usage of kerosene burner st ove or any other conventional type etc. is strictly prohibited. 6. The canteen staff should wear clean apron and suitable gloves while cooking and serving. 7. The sweeping and cleaning works are to be carried out as and when required to keep the c anteen hygienically clean at least twice a day. 8. The workers of the contractor should not be below the age 18 years and above the age of 60 years as on date of contract is effective. 9. Contractor should ensure payment of his workers as per minimum wages as applicable to A&N Island. 10. The mode of payment shall be monthly basis. The successful bidder must deposit the mon thly rent in form of Cheque in favour of Principal, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Institute of Technolog th y on or before 10 of every month to the Canteen Incharge. Non-payment of dues within d ue date is liable for payment of fine at the rate of Rs.100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) per day up to maximum of 10% of the Contractual cost, after attaining maximum of 10% of the contractual cost the contract is liable for termination. 11. The contractor will ensure all safety measures including fire risk due to equipment etc., be ing used in the Institute canteen premises. 12. The contractor would be bound to replace such worker(s) whose conduct and service are n

ot found satisfactory by the Institute. 13. Periodical medical examination of canteen staff for communicable disease, obtained from Competent Authority shall be displayed in the prominent place inside the canteen. 14. Subletting of the canteen is not permitted. 15. The canteen staff must be neatly dressed and behave well with the staff/students/visitors. 16. Contractor must display approved rates in prominent place. 17. The contractor may employ adequate number of employees at his expense for smooth an d efficient running of the canteen. He is responsible for proper and polite behavior of his e mployees in the canteen towards staff and students. 18. The canteen must be kept clean and in hygienic conditions. 19. The contractor will ensure that performance of the canteen is upto the satisfaction of the c ustomers and the service of the canteen staff is prompt and there is no undue delay. 20. The Security money / performance security deposited will also be liable to be forfeited or a ppropriated in the event of unsatisfactory performance of the contact or loss or damage if a ny, sustained by the Institute on account of failure or negligence on part of any labour of th e contractor. 21. The contract shall be cancelled any time within the contract period for non-satisfactory pe rformance or any reasons deemed fit by the college authorities. 22. A certificate from medical authority regarding hygienic condition of the canteen may also be produced by the successful bidder as and when required by the Institute under rule. 23. Any damages sustained to the Property/furniture etc. shall be recovered from the contract or at the actual rate of replacement. 24. The Contractor shall ensure that all fire extinguisher and maintain in proper working condi tions, regularly checked for expiry dates, and that employees are capable of operating the fire extinguisher effectively during emergencies and first aid kit to be available. 25. Contractor shall operate the canteen strictly during the timing fixed by the Institute i.e. 8 a m to 5 pm and no service beyond the college hours should be performed without permissio n of Competent Authority. 26. The contractor shall also provide services during functions / VVIP visits / workshops / confe rences or any other events as per the direction of Competent Authority. 27. Contractor should keep a complaint box inside the canteen which shall be regularly monito red by Canteen Incharge. 28. Closure of canteen services without prior approval is not permitted, if so, written request s hould be submitted at least 7 days in advance with the approval of committee. 29. Contractor should ensure that, sufficient quantity of food is made available in all canteen o perational hours, shortage of cooked food items is not permitted and supply of food should meet the daily demands. 30. Under no circumstances, shall the contractor reduce the quantity or quality of food in orde r to maintain lower prices as listed by the committee. 31. Proper lighting and ventilation is to be maintained in the college canteen in all time. 32. The contractor shall ensure usage of disposable glass / plates made of bio degradable mat erials and not of plastic or other non biodegradable materials are prohibited. Usage of reus able utensils such as stainless-steel plates, glasses, cups, spoons is permitted.

33. Fixing of sanitizer and other sanitary items in the canteen is the responsibility of the contr actor. 34. Strict action shall be taken against the contractor for any violations. 35. The Principal, DBRAIT will reserve the right to accept or reject any tender or all tender with out assigning any reason thereof.
